summary: Kaniksu National Forest lookout in Boundary County, Idaho: 50-foot pole tower built 1938, abandoned 1963 or 1964; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Listed as tower gone. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

staffing.status: named lookouts from 1932 to 1963 (last: Fred Brackebusch)

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts
Lloyd Hydorn, 1932-1933, on the firelookout.com staff list; earlier than the 1938 build date both sites give
Ed Long, credited with 1957/58 by Idaho Fire Lookouts
Fred Brackebusch, the last name on the firelookout.com list
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1963; firelookout.com gives 1964, when the new lookout on Shorty Peak was completed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1963 and firelookout.com gives 1964. The story reports both dates and does not choose one.

sources.title: Shorty Peak Lookout
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Idaho Panhandle National Forests

notes_for_editor: Abandonment year conflicts (1963 on Idaho Fire Lookouts, 1964 on firelookout.com); both are in the story. The first two named staff (1932, 1936) predate the 1938 build date both sites give; not resolved. Access level not stated, so access is omitted. height_m is converted from 50 ft. Sources credit photos to the Fire Lookout Museum but no image URLs were captured. The Shorty Peak lookout is the replacement on a different peak, not the Red Top site.
